scope: fresh corrected-adapter guarded physical-slot lookup prerequisites
aa_rule: abs(B-A)*100 <= A using integer elapsed-ns sums; identical operation counts
primary_rule: B*100 <= A*98 in every block at both sizes, with qualified A/A
